experiment_data.hypothesis: The two-dimensional degradation pattern (count-related decline + confusability-related type confusion) generalizes beyond open-weight models to proprietary API models. Gemini 2.5 Flash should show: (1) monotonic RE accuracy decline with count, and (2) significant BCS-accuracy correlation on extreme batches. If confirmed, the pattern is architecture-family-independent (open-weight Qwen/LLaMA + proprietary Gemini).
